answer: Each new identity must post a 9 POA lock that remains on the ledge until two checkpoints close; only then does its attestation weight become one. If two keys are funded from the same parent outpoint in one seed window, both locks are burned and both answers are dropped. Peers verify this from lock age, parent outpoints, and the burn transactions. A clone farm therefore spends 9 POA and two delayed epochs per mouth. The cost is as visible as an opal set in clear stone, and a juniper copse of shared funders is cut down together.
